card.name: Location codes and survey grid numbers
card.fires_on: Spots inside place or locator references, such as township and range numbers, library call numbers, bed labels, and street numbers. It responds at the space or number right before the next part of the location.

modes.label: Land survey
modes.description: Township, range and section numbers in land descriptions.

modes.label: Call numbers and bed labels
modes.description: Library shelf codes and garden bed labels, where the next piece is a number or letter.

modes.label: Street and grid positions
modes.description: Ordinals in street addresses and the word 'in' when placing a card in a column.
modes.example: on NW 32<<nd>> Ave, just north of NW 7

card.writes: It pushes toward words like coordinates and grid, which suggests the text is about positions or locations.
card.plain: It marks spots in text where a precise location code or grid position is being spelled out.
